verses.1:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the testimony, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.1:2: "Take the sum of all the congregation of Israel, according to kindreds, according to fathers' houses, according to the number by name, head by head:
verses.1:3: every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host of Israel, muster them with their host; you and Aaron shall muster them.
verses.1:4: And with you there shall be one for each tribe, each of the leaders; and they shall be according to fathers' houses.
verses.1:5: And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from the sons of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur;
verses.1:6: from Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;
verses.1:7: from Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;
verses.1:8: from Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar;
verses.1:9: from Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon; from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud;
verses.1:10: from Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
verses.1:11: from Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;
verses.1:12: from Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
verses.1:13: from Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran;
verses.1:14: from Gad, Eliasaph the son of Reuel;
verses.1:15: from Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan."
verses.1:16: These are the chosen of the congregation, leaders of the tribes according to their fathers' houses; they are the commanders of thousands in Israel.
verses.1:17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who had been called by name,
verses.1:18: and they assembled all the congregation on the first day of the month of the second year, and registered them according to their lineages, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, every male head by head,
verses.1:19: just as the Lord had commanded Moses; and they were mustered in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.1:20: And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:21: their muster from the tribe of Reuben was forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.1:22: For the sons of Simeon, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:23: their muster from the tribe of Simeon was fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.1:24: For the sons of Judah, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:25: their muster from the tribe of Judah was seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.1:26: For the sons of Issachar, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:27: their muster from the tribe of Issachar was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.1:28: For the sons of Zebulun, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:29: their muster from the tribe of Zebulun was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.1:30: For the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:31: their muster from the tribe of Ephraim was forty thousand five hundred.
verses.1:32: For the sons of Manasseh, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:33: their muster from the tribe of Manasseh was thirty-two thousand three hundred.
verses.1:34: For the sons of Benjamin, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:35: their muster from the tribe of Benjamin was thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.1:36: For the sons of Gad, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:37: their muster from the tribe of Gad was forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.1:38: For the sons of Dan, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:39: their muster from the tribe of Dan was sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.1:40: For the sons of Asher, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:41: their muster from the tribe of Asher was forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.1:42: For the sons of Naphtali, according to their kindreds, according to their families, according to their fathers' houses, according to the number of their names, head by head, all the males from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth in the host:
verses.1:43: their muster from the tribe of Naphtali was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.1:44: This is the muster which Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel mustered, twelve men; they were one man for each tribe, according to the tribe of their fathers' houses.
verses.1:45: And the entire muster of the sons of Israel in their host, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to array for battle in Israel, was
verses.1:46: six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
verses.1:47: But the Levites, from the tribe of their fathers' house, were not mustered among the sons of Israel.
verses.1:48: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.1:49: "See that you do not muster the tribe of Levi with them, nor take their number in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.1:50: And you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all things that are in it; they shall bear the tabernacle and all its vessels, and they shall minister in it, and they shall encamp around the tabernacle.
verses.1:51: And when the tabernacle is to set out, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to encamp, they shall raise it up; and the outsider who draws near shall die.
verses.1:52: And the sons of Israel shall encamp, each man in his own order and each man according to his own command, with their host;
verses.1:53: but let the Levites encamp before the Lord around the tabernacle of the testimony, and there shall be no sin among the sons of Israel; and the Levites themselves shall keep the watch of the tabernacle of the testimony."
verses.1:54: And the sons of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron; thus they did.
verses.2:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.2:2: "Every man keeping close by his own, according to division, according to ensigns, according to the houses of their fathers, let the children of Israel encamp; facing round about the tabernacle of the testimony, the children of Israel shall encamp.
verses.2:3: And those encamping toward the south, toward the east, shall be the division of the camp of Judah with their host, and the ruler of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab;
verses.2:4: his host, those who were numbered, is seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.2:5: And those encamping next to them shall be of the tribe of Issachar, and the ruler of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar;
verses.2:6: his host, those who were numbered, is fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.2:7: And those encamping next to them shall be of the tribe of Zebulun, and the ruler of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon;
verses.2:8: their host, those who were numbered, is fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.2:9: All who were numbered from the camp of Judah are one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, with their host; they shall set out first.
verses.2:10: The division of the camp of Reuben shall have their host toward the south, and the ruler of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur;
verses.2:11: his host, those who were numbered, is forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.2:12: And those encamping next to him shall be of the tribe of Simeon, and the ruler of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.2:13: His host, those who were numbered, is fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.2:14: And those encamping next to him shall be the tribe of Gad, and the ruler of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel;
verses.2:15: his host, those who were numbered, is forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.2:16: All who were numbered from the camp of Reuben are one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, with their host; they shall set out second.
verses.2:17: And the tabernacle of the testimony shall be taken up, and the camp of the Levites shall be in the midst of the camps; just as they encamp, so also shall they set out, each one in order according to leadership.
verses.2:18: The division of the camp of Ephraim shall be by the sea with their host, and the ruler of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.2:19: His host, those who were numbered, is forty thousand five hundred.
verses.2:20: And those encamping next to them shall be of the tribe of Manasseh, and the ruler of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
verses.2:21: his host, those who were numbered, is thirty-two thousand four hundred.
verses.2:22: And those encamping next to them shall be of the tribe of Benjamin, and the ruler of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni;
verses.2:23: his host, those who were numbered, is thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.2:24: All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim are one hundred eight thousand one hundred, with their host; they shall set out third.
verses.2:25: The division of the camp of Dan shall be toward the north with their host, and the ruler of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
verses.2:26: his host, those who were numbered, is sixty-two thousand five hundred.
verses.2:27: And those encamping next to him shall be of the tribe of Asher, and the ruler of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran;
verses.2:28: his host, those who were numbered, is forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.2:29: And those encamping next to them shall be of the tribe of Naphtali, and the ruler of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan;
verses.2:30: his host, those who were numbered, is fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.2:31: All who were numbered of the camp of Dan are one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred; they shall set out last, according to their division."
verses.2:32: This is the numbering of the children of Israel according to the houses of their fathers; the whole numbering of the camps with their hosts was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.2:33: But the Levites were not numbered together among them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.2:34: And the children of Israel did all that the Lord directed Moses; thus they encamped according to their division, and thus they set out, each keeping in order according to their clans, according to the houses of their fathers.
verses.3:1: And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day that the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.3:2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn Nadab, and Abiud, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.3:3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hands they consecrated to minister as priests.
verses.3:4: And Nadab and Abiud died before the Lord, as they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests with Aaron their father.
verses.3:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:6: "Take the tribe of Levi, and you shall set them before Aaron the priest, and they shall minister to him.
verses.3:7: And they shall keep his charges and the charges of the sons of Israel before the tabernacle of the testimony, to perform the works of the tabernacle;
verses.3:8: and they shall keep all the furnishings of the tabernacle of the testimony and the charges of the sons of Israel, according to all the works of the tabernacle.
verses.3:9: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons the priests; these are given as a gift to Me from the sons of Israel.
verses.3:10: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons over the tabernacle of the testimony, and they shall keep their priesthood and all things concerning the altar and within the veil; and the outsider who touches it shall die."
verses.3:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:12: "And behold, I Myself have taken the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb from among the sons of Israel; they shall be their ransom, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.3:13: For every firstborn is Mine; in the day that I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself every firstborn in Israel; from man to beast, they shall be Mine. I am the Lord."
verses.3:14: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.3:15: "Number the sons of Levi by the houses of their fathers, by their families; every male from a month old and upward, number them."
verses.3:16: And Moses and Aaron numbered them by the voice of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded them.
verses.3:17: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gedson, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.3:18: And these are the names of the sons of Gedson by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.3:20: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites by the houses of their fathers.
verses.3:21: Of Gedson was the family of Libni and the family of Shimei; these are the families of Gedson.
verses.3:22: Their numbering, according to the count of every male from a month old and upward, their numbering was seven thousand five hundred.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Gedson shall encamp behind the tabernacle by the sea;
verses.3:24: and the leader of the father's house of the family of Gedson was Eliasaph the son of Dael.
verses.3:25: And the charge of the sons of Gedson in the tabernacle of the testimony was the tabernacle and the covering, and the curtain of the door of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.3:26: and the hangings of the court, and the veil of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle, and the remainder of all its works.
verses.3:27: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these are the families of Kohath by number,
verses.3:28: every male from a month old and upward, eight thousand six hundred, keeping the charges of the holy things.
verses.3:29: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle toward the south;
verses.3:30: and the leader of the house of the fathers of the families of Kohath was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.3:31: And their charge was the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the curtain, and all their works.
verses.3:32: And the leader over the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, appointed to keep the charges of the holy things.
verses.3:33: Of Merari was the family of Mahli and the family of Mushi; these are the families of Merari.
verses.3:34: Their numbering by count, every male from a month old and upward, was six thousand fifty;
verses.3:35: and the leader of the father's house of the family of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail; they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle toward the north.
verses.3:36: The oversight and charge of the sons of Merari was the capitals of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all their furnishings, and their works,
verses.3:37: and the pillars of the court all around, and their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords.
verses.3:38: And those who encamp in front of the tabernacle of the testimony on the east are Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charges of the sanctuary for the charges of the sons of Israel; and the outsider who touches it shall die.
verses.3:39: All the numbering of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the voice of the Lord by their families, every male from a month old and upward, was twenty-two thousand.
verses.3:40: And the Lord said to Moses, saying, "Number every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number by name;
verses.3:41: and you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the Lord—in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the livestock of the sons of Israel."
verses.3:42: And Moses numbered, in the manner that the Lord commanded, every firstborn among the sons of Israel;
verses.3:43: and all the firstborn males, according to the number by name from a month old and upward from their numbering, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
verses.3:44: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:45: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock, and the Levites shall be Mine. I am the Lord.
verses.3:46: And as for the ransom, the two hundred seventy-three who exceed the Levites from among the firstborn of the sons of Israel,
verses.3:47: and you shall take five shekels per head; according to the holy didrachm you shall take them, twenty obols to the shekel;
verses.3:48: and you shall give the silver to Aaron and to his sons, the ransom of those who exceed among them."
verses.3:49: And Moses took the silver, the ransom of those who exceeded, for the redemption of the Levites;
verses.3:50: from the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the silver, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the holy shekel.
verses.3:51: And Moses gave the ransom of those who exceeded to Aaron and to his sons, by the voice of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.4:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses,
verses.4:3: from twenty-five years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister, to perform all the works in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:4: And these are the works of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of testimony: what is most holy.
verses.4:5: And Aaron and his sons shall enter whenever the camp sets out, and they shall take down the overshadowing veil and cover the ark of the testimony with it;
verses.4:6: and they shall place upon it a covering of blue leather, and spread over it a cloth wholly of blue on top, and insert the carrying poles.
verses.4:7: And upon the table set forth they shall spread a cloth wholly of purple, and place upon it the dishes, the censers, the cups, and the libation bowls with which he pours drink offerings; and the continual loaves shall be upon it.
verses.4:8: And they shall spread over it a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of blue leather, and insert the carrying poles through it.
verses.4:9: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that gives light, and its lamps, its tongs, its oil funnels, and all the vessels of oil with which they minister;
verses.4:10: and they shall put it and all its utensils into a covering of blue leather, and set it upon carrying poles.
verses.4:11: And over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of blue leather, and insert its carrying poles.
verses.4:12: And they shall take all the utensils of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them into a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of blue leather, and set them upon carrying poles.
verses.4:13: And he shall place the cover upon the altar, and they shall spread over it a cloth wholly of purple;
verses.4:14: and they shall place upon it all the utensils with which they minister upon it—the firepans, the fleshhooks, the bowls, the cover, and all the utensils of the altar—and they shall spread over it a covering of blue leather, and insert its carrying poles. And they shall take a purple cloth and cover the laver and its base, and put it into a covering of blue leather, and set it upon carrying poles.
verses.4:15: And Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things and all the holy utensils when the camp sets out; and after these things the sons of Kohath shall enter to carry them, and they shall not touch the holy things, lest they die. These things the sons of Kohath shall carry in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:16: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is overseer: the oil for the light, the compounded incense, the daily sacrifice, and the anointing oil—the oversight of the entire tabernacle and all that is in it, in the sanctuary, in all the works."
verses.4:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.4:18: "Do not destroy the clan of the tribe of Kohath from among the Levites.
verses.4:19: Do this for them, and they shall live and shall by no means die when they approach the most holy things: let Aaron and his sons go in, and they shall appoint each of them according to his burden.
verses.4:20: And they shall by no means enter to look suddenly upon the holy things, or they shall die."
verses.4:21: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:22: "Take the count of the sons of Gershon, them also, according to their fathers' houses, according to their clans;
verses.4:23: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old you shall number them, everyone who enters to minister, to perform his works in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:24: This is the ministry of the clan of Gershon, to minister and to carry:
verses.4:25: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of testimony, its covering, the blue covering that is upon it above, and the covering of the door of the tabernacle of testimony,
verses.4:26: and the hangings of the court that are by the tabernacle of testimony, and the remaining things; and all the utensils of ministry with which they minister, they shall attend to.
verses.4:27: By the word of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministry of the sons of Gershon, according to all their ministries and according to all the works performed by them; and you shall assign to them by name all the things to be carried by them.
verses.4:28: This is the ministry of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of testimony, and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.4:29: As for the sons of Merari, according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses, number them;
verses.4:30: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old you shall number them, everyone who enters to minister in the works of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:31: And these are the charges of the things carried by them, according to all the works in the tabernacle of testimony: the capitals of the tabernacle, the bars, its pillars, its bases, and the covering, and their bases and their pillars, and the covering of the door of the tabernacle,
verses.4:32: and the pillars of the court all around, and their bases, and the pillars of the veil of the gate of the court and their bases, and their pegs and their cords, and all their utensils and all their services; by name you shall number them and all the utensils of the charge of the things carried by them.
verses.4:33: This is the ministry of the clan of the sons of Merari, in all their works in the tabernacle of testimony, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest."
verses.4:34: And Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel numbered the sons of Kohath according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses,
verses.4:35: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who entered to minister and to work in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:36: And their numbering according to their clans was two thousand two hundred and fifty.
verses.4:37: This was the numbering of the clan of Kohath, everyone who ministered in the tabernacle of testimony, just as Moses and Aaron numbered them by the voice of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.4:38: And the sons of Gershon were numbered according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses,
verses.4:39: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who entered to minister and to perform the works in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:40: And their numbering according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses, was two thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.4:41: This was the numbering of the clan of the sons of Gershon, everyone who ministered in the tabernacle of testimony, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the voice of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.4:42: And the clan of the sons of Merari was also numbered according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses,
verses.4:43: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who entered to minister for the works of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:44: And their numbering according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses, was three thousand two hundred.
verses.4:45: This was the numbering of the clan of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the voice of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.4:46: All those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel numbered—the Levites—according to clans and according to fathers' houses,
verses.4:47: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who entered for the work of the works and the works of carrying in the tabernacle of testimony;
verses.4:48: and those who were numbered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
verses.4:49: By the voice of the Lord they were numbered through the hand of Moses, man by man, over their works and over what they carry; and they were numbered in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.5:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:2: "Command the children of Israel, and let them send out from the camp every leper, and everyone who has a discharge, and everyone who is unclean because of a dead body;
verses.5:3: from male to female, send them outside the camp, and they shall by no means defile their camps, in which I dwell among them."
verses.5:4: And the children of Israel did so, and sent them outside the camp; just as the Lord spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
verses.5:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:6: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'A man or a woman, whoever commits any of the sins of mankind, and willfully disregards, and that soul surely commits a trespass,
verses.5:7: he shall confess the sin which he has committed, and he shall restore the trespass, the principal sum, and add its fifth part to it, and give it to the one against whom he trespassed.
verses.5:8: But if the man has no near kinsman to whom to restore the trespass, the trespass that is restored to the Lord shall belong to the priest, besides the ram of atonement through which he shall make atonement with it on his behalf.
verses.5:9: And every firstfruits offering according to all the things consecrated among the children of Israel, whatever they offer to the Lord, to the priest, shall belong to him.
verses.5:10: And each man's consecrated things shall belong to him; whatever a man gives to the priest shall belong to him.'"
verses.5:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:12: "Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'If any man's wife goes astray and disregards him in contempt,
verses.5:13: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and she conceals it, yet she is defiled, and there was no witness with her and she has not been caught;
verses.5:14: and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, and she is indeed defiled, or a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, yet she is not defiled;
verses.5:15: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring the offering for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley flour; he shall pour no oil upon it nor put frankincense upon it, for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of remembrance, bringing sin to remembrance.
verses.5:16: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord;
verses.5:17: and the priest shall take pure living water in an earthen vessel, and of the earth that is on the floor of the tabernacle of testimony the priest shall take and cast it into the water;
verses.5:18: and the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the head of the woman, and place in her hands the offering of remembrance, the offering of jealousy; and in the hand of the priest shall be this water of conviction that brings a curse.
verses.5:19: And the priest shall put her under oath and say to the woman, "If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray to be defiled while under your husband, be free from this water of conviction that brings a curse.
verses.5:20: But if you have gone astray while under your husband, or have been defiled, and some man besides your husband has lain with you—"
verses.5:21: then the priest shall put the woman under oath with the words of this curse, and the priest shall say to the woman, "May the Lord make you a curse and an oath in the midst of your people, when the Lord causes your thigh to waste away and your belly to swell;
verses.5:22: and this water that brings a curse shall enter into your inward parts, to make your belly swell and your thigh waste away." And the woman shall say, "So be it, so be it."
verses.5:23: Then the priest shall write these curses in a book, and blot them out into the water of conviction that brings a curse;
verses.5:24: and he shall make the woman drink the water of conviction that brings a curse, and the water of conviction that brings a curse shall enter into her.
verses.5:25: And the priest shall take the offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand, and present the offering before the Lord and bring it to the altar;
verses.5:26: and the priest shall take a handful from the offering as its memorial portion and offer it up upon the altar, and afterward he shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.5:27: And it shall be, if she has been defiled and has utterly concealed it from her husband, then the water of conviction that brings a curse shall enter into her, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall waste away, and the woman shall become a curse to her people;
verses.5:28: but if the woman has not been defiled and is clean, then she shall be free and shall conceive seed.
verses.5:29: This is the law of jealousy, when a woman goes astray while under her husband and is defiled,
verses.5:30: or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a man and he becomes jealous of his wife; then he shall set his wife before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law;
verses.5:31: and the man shall be free from sin, but that woman shall bear her sin.'"
verses.6:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to the children of Israel,
verses.6:2: and you shall say to them, 'Any man or woman who solemnly vows a vow to consecrate himself in purity to the Lord
verses.6:3: from wine and strong drink, he shall keep himself pure from wine, and vinegar made from wine and vinegar made from strong drink he shall not drink, and whatever is produced from the grape he shall not drink, and fresh grapes and raisins he shall not eat.
verses.6:4: All the days of his vow, of all things that come from the vine—wine, from the grape skins even to the seed—he shall not eat.
verses.6:5: All the days of the consecration no razor shall come upon his head; until the days are fulfilled which he vowed to the Lord, he shall be holy, letting the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.6:6: All the days of the vow to the Lord he shall not go near any dead body. For father and for mother,
verses.6:7: and for brother and for sister, he shall not defile himself for them when they die, because the vow of his God is upon him, upon his head;
verses.6:8: all the days of his vow he shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.6:9: And if anyone dies very suddenly beside him, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled, and he shall shave his head on the day he is cleansed; on the seventh day he shall be shaved.
verses.6:10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony,
verses.6:11: and the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and one for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning what he sinned regarding the dead body, and he shall sanctify his head on that day on which he was consecrated to the Lord for the days of the vow,
verses.6:12: and he shall bring a year-old male lamb for a trespass offering; and the former days shall be void, because the head of his vow was defiled.
verses.6:13: And this is the law of the one who has made a vow: on the day when he fulfills the days of his vow, he himself shall present himself beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony;
verses.6:14: and he shall bring his gift to the Lord: one year-old male lamb without blemish for a burnt offering, and one year-old ewe lamb without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for a peace offering,
verses.6:15: and a basket of unleavened bread, loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their grain offering and their drink offering.
verses.6:16: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
verses.6:17: and the ram he shall offer as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall offer his grain offering and his drink offering.
verses.6:18: And the one who has made the vow shall shave the head of his vow beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and shall put the hair upon the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offering.
verses.6:19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, and one unleavened loaf from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall place them upon the hands of the one who made the vow, after he has shaved his vow;
verses.6:20: and the priest shall offer them as a presented offering before the Lord; it shall be holy for the priest, in addition to the breast of the presented offering and in addition to the shoulder of the portion set apart; and after these things the one who made the vow shall drink wine.
verses.6:21: This is the law of the one who has made a vow, who vows to the Lord his gift to the Lord concerning the vow, besides whatever else his hand may afford, according to the measure of his vow which he vows, according to the law of consecration.'"
verses.6:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:23: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, 'In this manner you shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them'—and they shall place My name upon the children of Israel, and I, the Lord, will bless them:
verses.6:24: 'May the Lord bless you and guard you,
verses.6:25: and may the Lord cause His face to shine upon you and have mercy upon you;
verses.6:26: may the Lord lift up His countenance upon you and grant you peace.'"
verses.7:1: And it came to pass on the day that Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, that he anointed it and sanctified it, and all its vessels, and the altar and all its vessels; and he anointed them and sanctified them.
verses.7:2: And the rulers of Israel made an offering, twelve rulers of the houses of their fathers—these were the rulers of the tribes, these were those who stood over the inspection.
verses.7:3: And they brought their gift before the Lord: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon from two rulers and a young bull from each one; and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.7:4: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:5: "Receive them from them, and they shall be for the works of service of the tabernacle of the testimony; and you shall give them to the Levites, to each according to his service."
verses.7:6: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
verses.7:7: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their services,
verses.7:8: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their services, through Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.7:9: But to the sons of Kohath he did not give any, because they have the ministries of the sanctuary; upon their shoulders they shall bear them.
verses.7:10: And the rulers brought gifts for the dedication of the altar on the day that he anointed it; and the rulers brought their gifts before the altar.
verses.7:11: And the Lord said to Moses, "One ruler each day, a ruler each day, they shall bring their gifts for the dedication of the altar."
verses.7:12: And the one who brought his gift on the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, ruler of the tribe of Judah.
verses.7:13: And he brought his gift: one silver platter, its weight one hundred and thirty, one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice;
verses.7:14: one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
verses.7:15: one young bull from the herd and one ram, a year-old lamb for a burnt offering;
verses.7:16: and one kid from the goats for a sin offering;
verses.7:17: and for a sacrifice of deliverance two heifers and five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.7:18: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, ruler of the tribe of Issachar, made an offering.

verses.7:89: When Moses entered into the tabernacle of the testimony to speak with Him, he heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from above the mercy seat that is upon the ark of the testimony, between the two cherubim; and He spoke to him.
verses.8:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to Aaron,
verses.8:2: and you shall say to him, 'When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light from the side in front of the lampstand.'"
verses.8:3: And Aaron did so; on the one side in front of the lampstand he kindled its lamps.
verses.8:4: And this was the construction of the lampstand: solid gold; its shaft and its lilies were wholly solid. According to the form which the Lord showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.8:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:6: "Take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and you shall purify them.
verses.8:7: And thus you shall perform their purification for them: you shall sprinkle water of purification upon them, and a razor shall pass over all their body, and they shall wash their garments, and they shall be clean.
verses.8:8: And they shall take one calf from the herd and its offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take a year-old calf from the herd for a sin offering.
verses.8:9: And you shall present the Levites before the tabernacle of the testimony, and you shall assemble all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.8:10: And you shall present the Levites before the Lord, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
verses.8:11: And Aaron shall set apart the Levites as a gift before the Lord from the sons of Israel, and they shall be appointed to perform the works of the Lord.
verses.8:12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the calves, and he shall offer the one for a sin offering and the one for a burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for them.
verses.8:13: And you shall set the Levites before the Lord, before Aaron and before his sons, and you shall present them as a gift before the Lord.
verses.8:14: And you shall separate the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be Mine.
verses.8:15: And after these things the Levites shall enter to perform the works of the tabernacle of the testimony; and you shall cleanse them, and present them before the Lord.
verses.8:16: For as a gift these have been given to Me from the midst of the sons of Israel; in place of all the firstborn who open every womb from among the sons of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
verses.8:17: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, from men even to livestock; on the day when I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for Myself.
verses.8:18: And I have taken the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.8:19: And I have presented the Levites as a gift given to Aaron and to his sons from the midst of the sons of Israel, to perform the works of the sons of Israel in the tabernacle of the testimony and to make atonement for the sons of Israel; and there shall not be among the sons of Israel anyone drawing near to the holy things."
verses.8:20: And Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites; so the sons of Israel did to them.
verses.8:21: And the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments; and Aaron presented them as a gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.
verses.8:22: And after these things the Levites went in to perform their ministry in the tabernacle of the testimony before Aaron and before his sons; just as the Lord directed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.8:23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:24: "This is what pertains to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall enter to work in the tabernacle of the testimony;
verses.8:25: and from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the ministry and shall no longer work,
verses.8:26: and his brother shall minister in the tabernacle of the testimony to keep the charges, but he shall not perform work. Thus you shall do to the Levites in their charges."
verses.9:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
verses.9:2: "Speak, and let the sons of Israel keep the Passover in its season.
verses.9:3: On the fourteenth day of the first month, toward evening, you shall keep it at the appointed times; according to its law and according to its ordinance you shall keep it."
verses.9:4: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to keep the Passover, beginning on the fourteenth day of the month in the wilderness of Sinai;
verses.9:5: just as the Lord directed Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.9:6: And the men who were unclean on account of a human corpse came forward, and they were not able to keep the Passover on that day; and they drew near before Moses and Aaron on that day.
verses.9:7: And those men said to him, "We are unclean on account of a human corpse; should we therefore fail to offer the gift to the Lord at its appointed time in the midst of the sons of Israel?"
verses.9:8: And Moses said to them, "Stand here, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
verses.9:9: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.9:10: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Any man who becomes unclean on account of a human corpse, or is on a journey far away, among you or among your generations, yet he shall keep the Passover to the Lord; in the second month, on the fourteenth day,
verses.9:11: toward evening, they shall keep it. With unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it;
verses.9:12: they shall not leave any of it until the morning, nor shall they break a bone of it; according to the law of the Passover they shall keep it.
verses.9:13: And the man who is clean and is not on a distant journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people; because he did not offer the gift to the Lord at its appointed time, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.9:14: And if a proselyte comes to you in your land and keeps the Passover to the Lord, according to the law of the Passover and according to its regulation he shall keep it; there shall be one law for you, both for the proselyte and for the native of the land.'"
verses.9:15: And on the day when the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the house of the testimony; and in the evening there was upon the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.
verses.9:16: So it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.9:17: And whenever the cloud went up from the tabernacle, then after that the sons of Israel set out; and in the place where the cloud stood, there the sons of Israel encamped.
verses.9:18: By the command of the Lord the sons of Israel shall encamp; by the command of the Lord they shall set out. All the days in which the cloud overshadows the tabernacle, the sons of Israel shall encamp.
verses.9:19: And whenever the cloud lingers upon the tabernacle for many days, then the sons of Israel shall keep the charge of God and shall by no means depart.
verses.9:20: And it shall be, whenever the cloud covers the tabernacle for a number of days, by the voice of the Lord they shall encamp, and by the command of the Lord they shall set out.
verses.9:21: And it shall be, whenever the cloud remains from evening until morning, and the cloud goes up in the morning, then they shall set out, by day or by night.
verses.9:22: For a month, or a day, while the cloud lingers longer overshadowing it, the sons of Israel shall encamp and shall by no means set out.
verses.9:23: For by the command of the Lord they shall set out—the charge of the Lord which they kept by the command of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.10:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Make for yourself two trumpets;
verses.10:2: of hammered silver you shall make them for yourself, and they shall be for you to summon the congregation and to move the camps.
verses.10:3: And you shall sound them, and all the congregation shall be gathered to the door of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.10:4: But if they sound with one, all the rulers, the leaders of Israel, shall come to you.
verses.10:5: And you shall sound an alarm, and the camps that encamp toward the east shall set out.
verses.10:6: And you shall sound a second alarm, and the camps that encamp toward the south shall set out; and you shall sound a third alarm, and the camps that encamp by the sea shall set out; and you shall sound a fourth alarm, and the camps that encamp toward the north shall set out; they shall sound with an alarm at their setting out.
verses.10:7: Yet when you gather the congregation together, you shall sound the trumpets, and not with an alarm.
verses.10:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall sound the trumpets; and it shall be to you an everlasting ordinance throughout your generations.
verses.10:9: And if you go out to war in your land against the adversaries who oppose you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you shall be remembered before the Lord, and you shall be delivered from your enemies.
verses.10:10: Also in the days of your gladness, and in your feasts, and at your new moons, you shall sound the trumpets over your whole burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your deliverance; and it shall be a memorial for you before your God: I am the Lord your God."
verses.10:11: Now it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud ascended from the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.10:12: And the sons of Israel set out with their belongings in the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stood still in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.10:13: And they first set out by the voice of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.10:14: And the division of the camp of the sons of Judah set out first with their host, and over their host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.10:15: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.10:16: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.10:17: And they shall take down the tabernacle, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari shall set out, carrying the tabernacle.
verses.10:18: And the division of the camp of Reuben set out with their host, and over their host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.10:19: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.10:20: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.10:21: And the sons of Kohath shall set out, carrying the holy things; and they shall set up the tabernacle before they arrive.
verses.10:22: And the division of the camp of Ephraim shall set out with their host; over their host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.10:23: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.10:24: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.10:25: And the division of the camp of the sons of Dan shall set out, the last of all the camps, with their host; and over their host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.10:26: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.10:27: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.10:28: These were the armies of the sons of Israel, and they set out with their host.
verses.10:29: Then Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, "We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, 'This I will give to you.' Come with us, and we will do good to you, for the Lord has spoken good things concerning Israel."
verses.10:30: And he said to him, "I will not go, but only to my land and to my kindred."
verses.10:31: And he said, "Do not forsake us, because you were with us in the wilderness, and you shall be an elder among us;
verses.10:32: and it shall be, if you go with us, that whatever good things the Lord shall bestow upon us, we also will do good to you."
verses.10:33: So they set out from the mountain of the Lord a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went ahead before them a journey of three days, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.10:34: And it came to pass, when the ark set out, that Moses said, "Arise, O Lord, let Your enemies be scattered, and let all who hate You flee!"
verses.10:35: And when it rested, he said, "Return, O Lord, the thousands and ten thousands in Israel."
verses.10:36: And the cloud became a shade over them by day, and when they set out from the camp.
verses.11:1: Now the people were murmuring wicked things before the Lord; and the Lord heard it and was kindled with wrath, and fire from the Lord broke out among them and consumed a part of the camp.
verses.11:2: Then the people cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire abated.
verses.11:3: And the name of that place was called Burning, because fire from the Lord had broken out among them.
verses.11:4: Now the mixed multitude who were among them craved with a strong craving; and the sons of Israel also sat down and wept, and said, "Who will feed us flesh?
verses.11:5: We remember the fish which we ate freely in Egypt, and the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
verses.11:6: but now our soul is parched; there is nothing at all, only upon the manna are our eyes."
verses.11:7: Now the manna is like coriander seed, and its appearance is the appearance of crystal.
verses.11:8: And the people went about and gathered it, and ground it in the mill and crushed it in the mortar, and boiled it in the pot and made it into hearth-cakes; and its savor was like the taste of a cake made with oil.
verses.11:9: And whenever the dew fell upon the camp by night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.11:10: And Moses heard them weeping throughout their families, each man at his door; and the Lord was exceedingly kindled with wrath, and before Moses it was evil.
verses.11:11: And Moses said to the Lord, "Why have You afflicted Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid the impulse of this people upon me?
verses.11:12: Did I conceive all this people, or did I give birth to them, that You say to me, 'Take them into your bosom, as a nurse carries the nursing child,' to the land which You swore to their fathers?
verses.11:13: Where am I to get flesh to give to all this people? For they weep before me, saying, 'Give us flesh, that we may eat.'
verses.11:14: I will not be able by myself alone to bear this people, because this matter is too heavy for me.
verses.11:15: And if You deal thus with me, put me utterly to death, if I have found mercy with You, that I may not see my affliction."
verses.11:16: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Gather to Me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you yourself have perceived to be elders of the people and their scribes; and you shall bring them to the tabernacle of testimony, and they shall stand there with you.
verses.11:17: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take from the Spirit who is upon you and lay the same upon them; and they shall share with you the impulse of the people, and you shall not bear them yourself alone.
verses.11:18: And to the people you shall say, 'Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat flesh; for you have wept before the Lord, saying, "Who will feed us flesh? For it is well with us in Egypt." Therefore the Lord will give you flesh to eat, and you shall eat flesh.
verses.11:19: You shall not eat one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.11:20: for a month of days you shall eat, until flesh comes out of your nostrils and becomes nausea to you; because you have disobeyed the Lord who is among you, and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we come out of Egypt?"'"
verses.11:21: And Moses said to the Lord, "Six hundred thousand footmen are the people among whom I am, and You have said, 'Flesh I will give them to eat, and they shall eat for a month of days.'
verses.11:22: Shall sheep and oxen be slaughtered for them, and will it suffice for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, and will it suffice for them?"
verses.11:23: And the Lord said to Moses, "Will the hand of the Lord not suffice? Now you shall know whether My word shall overtake you or not."
verses.11:24: So Moses went out and spoke to the people the words of the Lord, and he gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and stationed them around the tabernacle.
verses.11:25: And the Lord came down in a cloud and spoke to him, and He took from the Spirit who was upon him and laid the same upon the seventy men, the elders; and as soon as the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and they did not do so anymore.
verses.11:26: Now two men remained in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad and the name of the second was Medad, and the Spirit rested upon them; and these were among those who had been enrolled, yet they had not come to the tabernacle, and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.11:27: And the young man ran and reported to Moses, and spoke, saying, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.11:28: And Joshua the son of Nun, who attended Moses, the chosen one, answered and said, "Lord Moses, restrain them."
verses.11:29: And Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for my sake? And who would grant that all the people of the Lord were prophets, whenever the Lord puts His Spirit upon them?"
verses.11:30: Then Moses departed into the camp, both he and the elders of Israel.
verses.11:31: And a wind went forth from the Lord and brought quail across from the sea, and cast them upon the camp, a day's journey on this side and a day's journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the ground.
verses.11:32: And the people rose up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quail; he who gathered the least gathered ten cors; and they slaughtered them to dry for themselves all around the camp.
verses.11:33: The flesh was still between their teeth, before it was exhausted, when the Lord was kindled with wrath against His people; and the Lord struck the people with an exceedingly great plague.
verses.11:34: And the name of that place was called Graves of Craving; there they buried the people who craved.
verses.11:35: From Graves of Craving the people set out to Hazeroth, and the people were at Hazeroth.
verses.12:1: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom Moses had taken, for he had taken an Ethiopian woman.
verses.12:2: And they said, "Has the Lord spoken to Moses alone? Has He not spoken to us also?" And the Lord heard.
verses.12:3: Now the man Moses was exceedingly meek, more than all the men who were upon the earth.
verses.12:4: And the Lord said to Moses, Miriam, and Aaron, "Come out, you three, to the tabernacle of testimony." And the three went out to the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.12:5: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the door of the tabernacle of testimony; and Aaron and Miriam were called, and both of them came forth.
verses.12:6: And He said to them, "Hear My words: If there is a prophet of yours for the Lord, I will make Myself known to him in a vision, and I will speak to him in sleep.
verses.12:7: Not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
verses.12:8: Mouth to mouth I will speak to him, in visible form and not through riddles, and he has beheld the glory of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?"
verses.12:9: And the fierce wrath of the Lord was upon them, and He departed.
verses.12:10: And the cloud withdrew from the tabernacle, and behold, Miriam was leprous, like snow. And Aaron looked upon Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
verses.12:11: Then Aaron said to Moses, "I implore you, lord, do not lay sin upon us, because we acted in ignorance in that we have sinned.
verses.12:12: Do not let her become like one equal to death, like an untimely birth coming forth from a mother's womb; it devours half of her flesh."
verses.12:13: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "O God, I implore You, heal her."
verses.12:14: And the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had surely spat in her face, would she not be ashamed seven days? Let her be set apart seven days outside the camp, and after that she shall come in."
verses.12:15: So Miriam was set apart outside the camp seven days; and the people did not set out until Miriam was cleansed.
verses.12:16: And after that the people set out from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.13:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.13:2: "Send out men for yourself, and let them spy out the land of the Canaanites, which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession; one man from each tribe, sending them according to the clans of their fathers' houses, every one a leader among them."
verses.13:3: So Moses sent them forth from the wilderness of Paran by the voice of the Lord; all these men were leaders of the sons of Israel.
verses.13:4: And these are their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Samuel the son of Zaccur;
verses.13:5: of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Suri;
verses.13:6: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
verses.13:7: of the tribe of Issachar, Ilaal the son of Joseph;
verses.13:8: of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
verses.13:9: of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
verses.13:10: of the tribe of Zebulun, Gudiel the son of Sodi;
verses.13:11: of the tribe of Joseph, of the sons of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
verses.13:12: of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gamai;
verses.13:13: of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
verses.13:14: of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Jabi;
verses.13:15: of the tribe of Gad, Gudiel the son of Machi.
verses.13:16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses gave Hoshea the son of Nun the name Joshua.
verses.13:17: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up by this wilderness, and you shall go up into the mountain;
verses.13:18: and you shall see the land, what it is, and the people who dwell upon it, whether they are stronger or weak, or whether they are few or many;
verses.13:19: and what the land is in which they dwell, whether it is good or bad; and what the cities are in which they abide, whether in walled cities or in unwalled ones;
verses.13:20: and what the land is, whether rich or exhausted, whether there are trees in it or not. And being steadfast, you shall take from the fruits of the land." Now the days were the days of spring, the firstfruits of the grape.
verses.13:21: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, at the entrance of Ephaath.
verses.13:22: And they went up through the wilderness and came to Hebron; and there were Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak. Now Hebron was built seven years before Tanis of Egypt.
verses.13:23: And they came to the Valley of the Cluster and spied it out; and from there they cut off vine branches and one cluster of grapes upon it, and they carried it on poles, along with some of the pomegranates and of the cucumbers.
verses.13:24: That place they named Valley of the Cluster, because of the cluster which the sons of Israel cut off from there.
verses.13:25: And after spying out the land, they returned from there after forty days.
verses.13:26: And they departed and came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, into the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; and they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed the fruit of the land.
verses.13:27: And they recounted it to him and said, "We came into the land to which you sent us, a land flowing with milk and honey, and this is its fruit;
verses.13:28: yet the nation that dwells upon it is bold, and the cities are strong, walled, and exceedingly great; and we saw the descendants of Anak there;
verses.13:29: and Amalek dwells in the land toward the south, and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Amorite dwell in the hill country, and the Canaanite dwells by the sea."
verses.13:30: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said to him, "No, rather we shall surely go up and inherit it, for we are indeed able to prevail against them."
verses.13:31: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not going up, for we are by no means able to go up against the nation, for it is far stronger than we."
verses.13:32: And they brought dismay concerning the land which they had spied out to the sons of Israel, saying, "The land through which we passed to spy it out is a land that devours those who dwell upon it; all the people whom we saw in it are men of exceeding stature there;
verses.13:33: and there we saw the giants, and we were before them like locusts; and indeed so we were before them."
verses.14:1: And all the congregation lifted up their voice and cried out, and the people wept all that night.
verses.14:2: And all the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron, and all the congregation said to them,
verses.14:3: "If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if we had died in this wilderness! And why is the Lord bringing us into this land to fall in war? Our wives and little ones will become plunder; now therefore it is better for us to return to Egypt."
verses.14:4: And they said one to another, "Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt."
verses.14:5: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.14:6: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who had spied out the land, tore their garments,
verses.14:7: and spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "The land which we spied out is exceedingly, exceedingly good.
verses.14:8: If the Lord chooses us, He will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.14:9: Yet do not become rebels against the Lord; and do not fear the people of the land, for they are food for us; for the season has departed from them, but the Lord is among us; do not fear them."
verses.14:10: And all the congregation said to stone them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud upon the tabernacle of testimony to all the sons of Israel.
verses.14:11: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long will this people provoke Me? And how long will they not believe Me, for all the signs which I have done among them?
verses.14:12: I will strike them with death and destroy them, and I will make you and the house of your father into a great and much more numerous nation than this."
verses.14:13: And Moses said to the Lord, "Then Egypt will hear, for by Your might You brought this people out from among them;
verses.14:14: moreover, all who dwell upon this land have heard that You are the Lord among this people, You who are seen eye to eye, O Lord; and Your cloud stands over them, and in a pillar of cloud You go along before them by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.14:15: Now if You wipe out this people as one man, then the nations, all who have heard Your name, will speak, saying,
verses.14:16: 'Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which He swore to them, He laid them low in the wilderness.'
verses.14:17: And now let Your strength be exalted, O Lord, just as You spoke, saying,
verses.14:18: 'The Lord is longsuffering and abounding in mercy and true, taking away lawlessness and unrighteousness and sins; and He will by no means clear the guilty, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation.'
verses.14:19: Forgive the sin of this people according to Your great mercy, just as You have been gracious to them from Egypt even until now."
verses.14:20: And the Lord said to Moses, "I am gracious to them according to your word;
verses.14:21: yet as I live, and as My name lives, the glory of the Lord shall indeed fill all the earth:
verses.14:22: for all the men who have seen My glory and the signs which I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tested Me this tenth time and have not heeded My voice,
verses.14:23: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers; rather, their children who are with Me here, as many as do not know good or evil, every inexperienced youth—to these I will give the land; but all who provoked Me shall not see it.
verses.14:24: But My servant Caleb, because another spirit was in him and he followed Me, I will bring him into the land into which he entered, and his seed shall inherit it.
verses.14:25: Now Amalek and the Canaanite dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn back and depart into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea."
verses.14:26: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.14:27: "How long shall I bear with this wicked congregation? They murmur against Me; I have heard the murmuring of the sons of Israel, which they have murmured concerning you.
verses.14:28: Say to them, 'As I live, says the Lord, surely just as you have spoken in My ears, so I will do to you:
verses.14:29: in this wilderness your carcasses shall fall, and all your census and those of you who were numbered from twenty years old and upward, as many as murmured against Me.
verses.14:30: You shall by no means enter into the land over which I stretched out My hand to cause you to dwell upon it, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.14:31: But the little ones, whom you said would become plunder, I will bring them into the land, and they shall inherit the land from which you turned away.
verses.14:32: And your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness;
verses.14:33: and your sons shall be pasturing in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your harlotry, until your carcasses are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.14:34: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, for each day a year, you shall bear your sins forty years, and you shall know the fury of My wrath.
verses.14:35: I the Lord have spoken: surely I will do this to this wicked congregation that has banded together against Me; in this wilderness they shall be utterly consumed, and there they shall die.'"
verses.14:36: Now the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and murmured against it to the congregation, so as to bring forth evil words concerning the land,
verses.14:37: even those men who spoke evil against the land died by the plague before the Lord.
verses.14:38: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who had gone to spy out the land.
verses.14:39: And Moses spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, and the people mourned exceedingly.
verses.14:40: And rising early in the morning, they went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Behold, here we are; we will go up to the place of which the Lord spoke, for we have sinned."
verses.14:41: And Moses said, "Why do you transgress the word of the Lord? It will not go well for you.
verses.14:42: Do not go up, for the Lord is not with you, and you will fall before the face of your enemies.
verses.14:43: For Amalek and the Canaanite are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you turned away, disobeying the Lord, the Lord will not be among you."
verses.14:44: Yet forcing their way, they went up to the top of the mountain; but the ark of the covenant of the Lord and Moses did not move from the camp.
verses.14:45: Then Amalek and the Canaanite who dwelt in that mountain came down, and routed them and cut them down as far as Hormah; and they returned to the camp.
verses.15:1: And the Lord said to Moses, saying, "Speak to the children of Israel,
verses.15:2: and you shall say to them, 'When you enter the land of your habitation, which I am giving to you,
verses.15:3: and you shall offer burnt offerings to the Lord, a whole burnt offering or a sacrifice, to magnify a vow or as a freewill offering, or in your feasts, to make a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord, whether from the cattle or from the sheep;
verses.15:4: then he who brings his gift to the Lord shall present an offering of fine flour, a tenth of an ephah, mixed with oil, a fourth of a hin;
verses.15:5: and wine for a drink offering, a fourth of a hin, you shall prepare with the burnt offering or with the sacrifice; for each lamb you shall prepare this much, an offering made by fire, a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord.
verses.15:6: And for a ram, when you offer it either for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, you shall prepare an offering of fine flour, two-tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin;
verses.15:7: and wine for a drink offering, a third of a hin, you shall present for a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord.
verses.15:8: And if you offer from the cattle for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to magnify a vow as a peace offering to the Lord,
verses.15:9: then he shall present with the calf an offering of fine flour, three-tenths, mixed with oil, half a hin,
verses.15:10: an offering made by fire, a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord.
verses.15:11: Thus you shall do for each calf, or for each ram, or for each lamb from the sheep or from the goats;
verses.15:12: according to the number that you prepare, so you shall do for each one according to their number.
verses.15:13: Everyone who is native-born shall do such things in this manner, to present offerings made by fire for a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord.
verses.15:14: And if a proselyte joins you in your land, or whoever is among you throughout your generations, and shall prepare an offering made by fire, a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord, in the manner that you do, so shall the congregation do to the Lord.
verses.15:15: There shall be one law for you and for the proselytes who are joined among you, an everlasting law throughout your generations; as you are, so also shall the proselyte be before the Lord.
verses.15:16: There shall be one law and one ordinance also for the proselyte who is joined among you.'"
verses.15:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:18: "Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'When you come into the land to which I am bringing you,
verses.15:19: then it shall be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall set aside a contribution, a separated offering to the Lord;
verses.15:20: the firstfruits of your dough, a loaf as a contribution, you shall set it apart; as a contribution from the threshing floor, so shall you set it aside,
verses.15:21: the firstfruits of your dough; and you shall give to the Lord a contribution throughout your generations.
verses.15:22: And when you err and do not perform all these commandments which the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.15:23: just as the Lord commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded you and onward throughout your generations;
verses.15:24: then it shall be, if it is done unintentionally out of the sight of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one calf from the cattle without blemish for a burnt offering, for a sweet-smelling aroma to the Lord, and its offering and its drink offering according to the ordinance, and one kid from the goats for a sin offering.
verses.15:25: And the priest shall make atonement for it, for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it is unintentional; and they have brought their gift, an offering made by fire to the Lord, for their sin before the Lord, for their unintentional errors.
verses.15:26: And it shall be forgiven throughout all the congregation of the children of Israel and to the proselyte who is joined to you, because for all the people it was unintentional.
verses.15:27: And if one soul sins unintentionally, he shall bring one female goat a year old for a sin offering;
verses.15:28: and the priest shall make atonement for the soul who erred unintentionally and sinned unintentionally before the Lord, to make atonement for him.
verses.15:29: For the native among the children of Israel and for the proselyte who is joined among them, there shall be one law for them, for whoever acts unintentionally.
verses.15:30: And the soul who acts with a hand of arrogance, whether from the native-born or from the proselytes, that one provokes God; that soul shall be utterly destroyed from among his people.
verses.15:31: Because he has despised the words of the Lord and has broken His commandments, that soul shall surely be blotted out; his sin is upon him.'"
verses.15:32: And the children of Israel were in the wilderness, and they found a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.15:33: And those who found him gathering wood on the Sabbath day brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.15:34: And they placed him under guard, for they had not determined what they should do to him.
verses.15:35: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "The man shall surely be put to death; stone him with stones, all the congregation."
verses.15:36: And all the congregation brought him outside the camp; and all the congregation stoned him with stones outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.15:37: And the Lord said to Moses, saying,
verses.15:38: "Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to them, and let them make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments throughout their generations; and you shall put upon the fringes of the corners a cord of blue.
verses.15:39: And it shall be for you in the fringes, and you shall look upon them and remember all the commandments of the Lord and perform them, and you shall not be turned aside after your thoughts and eyes, after which you play the harlot; so that you may remember and perform all My commandments,
verses.15:40: and you shall be holy to your God.
verses.15:41: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I am the Lord your God."
verses.16:1: Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, the son of Reuben, spoke;
verses.16:2: and they rose up before Moses, with two hundred and fifty men of the sons of Israel, leaders of the congregation, summoned to the council, and men of renown.
verses.16:3: They banded together against Moses and Aaron and said, "Let it be enough for you, for all the congregation—every one of them—are holy, and the Lord is among them. Why then do you rise up over the congregation of the Lord?"
verses.16:4: And when Moses heard this, he fell on his face,
verses.16:5: and he spoke to Korah and to all his congregation, saying, "God has examined and knows those who are His and those who are holy, and He has brought them near to Himself; and those whom He has chosen for Himself, He has brought near to Himself.
verses.16:6: Do this: take censers for yourselves, Korah and all his congregation,
verses.16:7: and put fire in them, and place incense upon them before the Lord tomorrow; and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses, he is holy. Let it be enough for you, sons of Levi."
