verses.16:8: And Moses said to Korah, "Hear me, sons of Levi.
verses.16:9: Is this a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and has brought you near to Himself, to perform the services of the tabernacle of the Lord and to stand before the tabernacle to serve them,
verses.16:10: and that He has brought you near, and all your brethren the sons of Levi with you? And do you seek to serve as priests also?
verses.16:11: Thus you and all your congregation are gathered together against God; and who is Aaron, that you murmur against him?"
verses.16:12: And Moses sent to summon Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab; and they said, "We will not come up.
verses.16:13: Is this a small thing, that you have brought us up into a land flowing with milk and honey, to slay us in the wilderness, that you altogether rule over us?
verses.16:14: Even if you had brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey and had given us an inheritance of field and vineyards, you would have put out the eyes of those men. We will not come up."
verses.16:15: Then Moses was exceedingly indignant, and said to the Lord, "Do not pay regard to their offering; I have not taken anything desirable from any one of them, nor have I harmed any one of them."
verses.16:16: And Moses said to Korah, "Sanctify your congregation, and be ready before the Lord, you and they, and Aaron, tomorrow;
verses.16:17: and take, each of you, his censer, and you shall place incense upon them, and you shall bring before the Lord each one his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; and you and Aaron, each one his censer."
verses.16:18: So each man took his censer, and they put fire in them, and laid incense upon it; and Moses and Aaron stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.16:19: And Korah assembled all his congregation against them by the door of the tabernacle of testimony. Then the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
verses.16:20: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.16:21: "Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and I will consume them at once."
verses.16:22: And they fell on their faces and said, "O God, God of the spirits and of all flesh, if one man has sinned, shall the wrath of the Lord be upon all the congregation?"
verses.16:23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.16:24: "Speak to the congregation, saying, 'Withdraw from all around the congregation of Korah.'"
verses.16:25: Then Moses arose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and all the elders of Israel went with him.
verses.16:26: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Separate yourselves from the tents of these harsh men, and do not touch anything of all that belongs to them, lest you perish together with all your belongings."
verses.16:27: So they withdrew from all around the tent of Korah; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood by the doors of their tents, with their wives, their children, and their dependents.
verses.16:28: And Moses said, "By this you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, for they are not from myself:
verses.16:29: if these men die according to the death of all men, and if their visitation shall be according to the visitation of all men, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.16:30: But if the Lord shows it by a marvel, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them up, with their households and their tents and all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into Hades, then you shall know that these men have provoked the Lord."
verses.16:31: Now as he finished speaking all these words, the earth split apart beneath them,
verses.16:32: and the earth opened and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who were with Korah, and their livestock.
verses.16:33: So they and all that was theirs went down alive into Hades; and the earth covered them, and they perished from the midst of the congregation.
verses.16:34: And all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they were saying, "Lest the earth swallow us up!"
verses.16:35: And fire came forth from the Lord and devoured the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the incense.
verses.17:1: And the Lord said to Moses
verses.17:2: and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, "Take up the bronze censers out of the midst of those who were burned, and scatter this strange fire over there, for they have consecrated the censers of these sinners at the cost of their lives;
verses.17:3: and make them into hammered plates as a covering for the altar, because they were offered before the Lord and were sanctified, and they have become a sign to the sons of Israel."
verses.17:4: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered, and they affixed them as a covering for the altar,
verses.17:5: as a memorial to the sons of Israel, so that no outsider, who is not of the seed of Aaron, should draw near to place incense before the Lord, and that he may not become like Korah and his faction, just as the Lord spoke to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.17:6: And on the next day the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have slain the people of the Lord."
verses.17:7: And it came to pass, as the congregation was banding together against Moses and Aaron, that they rushed toward the tabernacle of testimony; and as for it, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.17:8: And Moses and Aaron went before the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.17:9: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.17:10: "Depart from the midst of this congregation, and I will consume them at once." And they fell on their faces.
verses.17:11: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take the censer, and put fire in it from the altar, and lay incense upon it, and carry it swiftly into the camp, and it shall make atonement for them; for wrath has gone forth from the presence of the Lord, and it has begun to strike down the people."
verses.17:12: And Aaron took it just as Moses had spoken to him, and ran into the congregation; and already the plague had begun among the people. And he put on the incense and made atonement for the people;
verses.17:13: and he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague ceased among the people.
verses.17:14: Now those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on account of Korah.
verses.17:15: And Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tabernacle of testimony, and the plague ceased.
verses.17:16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:17: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from them a rod—a rod for each of their fathers' houses from all their leaders, according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods; and write each man's name upon the rod.
verses.17:18: And write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi; for there is one rod; according to the tribe of their fathers' house they shall give it.
verses.17:19: And you shall place them in the tabernacle of testimony before the testimony, where I will be made known to you there.
verses.17:20: And it shall be that the man whom I choose, his rod shall sprout; and I will take away from Me the murmuring of the sons of Israel, which they murmur against you."
verses.17:21: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their leaders gave him a rod—a rod for each leader, one for every leader, according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.17:22: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.17:23: And it came to pass on the next day that Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of testimony, and behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted, and brought forth buds, and put forth blossoms, and yielded nuts.
verses.17:24: Then Moses brought out all the rods from the presence of the Lord to all the sons of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his own rod.
verses.17:25: And the Lord said to Moses, "Lay up the rod of Aaron before the testimonies for safekeeping, as a sign to the sons of the disobedient; and let their murmuring cease from Me, so that they shall not die."
verses.17:26: And Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.17:27: And the sons of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Behold, we are consumed, we have perished, we are utterly spent!
verses.17:28: Everyone who touches the tabernacle of the Lord dies. Shall we die to the very end?"
verses.18:1: And the Lord said to Aaron, saying, "You and your sons and the house of your ancestral family shall receive the firstfruits of the holy things; you and your sons shall bear the sins of your priesthood.
verses.18:2: And your brethren, the tribe of Levi, the clan of your father, bring near to yourself, and let them be joined to you and minister to you; and you and your sons with you shall be before the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.18:3: And they shall keep your charges and the charges of the tabernacle; only they shall not draw near to the holy vessels and to the altar, and neither they nor you shall die.
verses.18:4: And they shall be joined to you, and they shall keep the charges of the tabernacle of the testimony according to all the ministries of the tabernacle; and the outsider shall not draw near to you.
verses.18:5: And you shall keep the charges of the holy things and the charges of the altar, and there shall be no wrath among the children of Israel.
verses.18:6: And I have taken your brethren the Levites from the midst of the children of Israel, a gift given to the Lord, to perform the ministries of the tabernacle of the testimony;
verses.18:7: and you and your sons with you shall guard your priesthood, in every manner concerning the altar and that which is within the veil, and you shall perform the ministries as a gift of your priesthood; and the outsider who comes near shall die."
verses.18:8: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, "And behold, I have given you the keeping of the firstfruits from all the things consecrated to Me by the children of Israel; to you I have given them as a gift of honor, and to your sons after you, as a perpetual statute.
verses.18:9: And this shall be yours from the consecrated holy things of the offerings made by fire: from all their gifts, and from all their sacrifices, and from all their trespass offerings, and from all the sin offerings, whatever they render to Me from all the holy things, shall belong to you and to your sons.
verses.18:10: In the Holy of Holies you shall eat them; every male shall eat them, you and your sons; they shall be holy to you.
verses.18:11: And this shall be yours of the firstfruits of their gifts, from all the presentation offerings of the children of Israel; to you I have given them, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a perpetual statute; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat them.
verses.18:12: Every firstfruit of olive oil and every firstfruit of wine, their firstfruit of grain, whatever they give to the Lord, to you I have given them.
verses.18:13: All the first produce, whatever is in their land, whatever they bring to the Lord, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat them.
verses.18:14: Everything devoted among the children of Israel shall be yours.
verses.18:15: And everything that opens the womb of all flesh, which they offer to the Lord, from man to beast, shall be yours; nevertheless, the firstborn of men shall surely be redeemed with a ransom, and the firstborn of unclean beasts you shall redeem.
verses.18:16: And its redemption shall be from one month old; the valuation shall be five shekels according to the holy shekel, which is twenty obols.
verses.18:17: However, the firstborn of calves and the firstborn of sheep and the firstborn of goats you shall not redeem; they are holy; and you shall pour out their blood against the altar, and the fat you shall offer up as an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the Lord;
verses.18:18: and the flesh shall be yours; even the breast of the presentation offering, and as with the right shoulder, it shall be yours.
verses.18:19: Every contribution of the holy things, whatever the children of Israel set apart to the Lord, I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a perpetual statute; it is a covenant of perpetual salt before the Lord for you and for your seed after you."
verses.18:20: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, "In their land you shall have no inheritance, and there shall be no portion for you among them, because I am your portion and your inheritance in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.18:21: And to the sons of Levi, behold, I have given every tithe in Israel as an allotment in return for their ministries, all the ministry that they perform in the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.18:22: And the children of Israel shall no longer draw near to the tabernacle of the testimony, to bear deadly sin.
verses.18:23: And the Levite himself shall perform the ministry of the tabernacle of the testimony, and they shall bear their sins, a perpetual statute throughout their generations; and in the midst of the children of Israel they shall not inherit an inheritance.
verses.18:24: For the tithes of the children of Israel, whatever they separate to the Lord as a contribution, I have given to the Levites as an allotment; therefore I have said to them, 'In the midst of the children of Israel they shall not inherit an allotment.'"
verses.18:25: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.18:26: "And to the Levites you shall speak and say to them, 'When you receive from the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them as an allotment, then you yourselves shall set apart from it a contribution to the Lord, a tithe from the tithe.
verses.18:27: And your contributions shall be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor and as a contribution from the winepress.
verses.18:28: Thus you yourselves shall also set them apart from the contributions of the Lord, from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Israel; and from them you shall give a contribution to Aaron the priest.
verses.18:29: From all your gifts you shall set apart a contribution to the Lord, or from all the firstfruits the consecrated part of it.'
verses.18:30: And you shall say to them, 'When you set apart the firstfruit from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as produce from the threshing floor and as produce from the winepress,
verses.18:31: and you shall eat it in every place, you and your households, because this is your wages in return for your ministries in the tabernacle of the testimony;
verses.18:32: and you shall not bear sin on account of it, when you set apart the firstfruit from it; and the holy things of the children of Israel you shall not profane, lest you die.'"
verses.19:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.19:2: "This is the ordinance of the law, all that the Lord has commanded, saying, 'Speak to the children of Israel, and let them bring to you a red heifer without blemish, which has no blemish in her and upon which no yoke has been laid.
verses.19:3: And you shall give her to Eleazar the priest; and they shall bring her forth outside the camp to a clean place, and they shall slaughter her before him;
verses.19:4: and Eleazar shall take some of her blood, and shall sprinkle some of her blood seven times opposite the front of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.19:5: And they shall burn her up before him; both her hide and her flesh and her blood, together with her dung, shall be burned up.
verses.19:6: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and they shall cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.19:7: Then the priest shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; and the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:8: And the one who burns her up shall wash his garments and bathe his body, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:9: And a clean man shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. And it shall be for the congregation of the children of Israel for safekeeping; it is water of sprinkling, it is a purification.
verses.19:10: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and he shall be unclean until evening; and it shall be a perpetual statute for the children of Israel and for the proselytes who are joined to them.
verses.19:11: He who touches the dead body of any human soul shall be unclean seven days;
verses.19:12: this one shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be clean; but if he is not purified on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
verses.19:13: Everyone who touches the dead body of a human soul, if one dies, and is not purified, has defiled the tabernacle of the Lord; that soul shall be wiped out from Israel, because the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him; he is unclean, his uncleanness is still in him.
verses.19:14: And this is the law: if a man dies in a house, everyone who enters into the house and all that is in the house shall be unclean seven days;
verses.19:15: and every open vessel that does not have a fastening bound upon it is unclean.
verses.19:16: And everyone who touches on the face of the open field one slain, or a corpse, or a human bone, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:17: And for the unclean person they shall take some of the burned ashes of the purification, and they shall pour living water upon them into a vessel;
verses.19:18: and a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it into the water, and shall sprinkle it upon the house, and upon the vessels, and upon the souls, as many as are there, and upon the one who has touched the human bone, or the slain one, or the dead body, or the grave;
verses.19:19: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be purified on the seventh day; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:20: And any man who is defiled and is not purified, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord; because the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he is unclean.
verses.19:21: And it shall be a perpetual statute for you; and the one who sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his garments, and the one who touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening;
verses.19:22: and whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.'"
verses.20:1: And the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people remained in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.20:2: Now there was no water for the congregation, and they assembled together against Moses and Aaron.
verses.20:3: And the people railed against Moses, saying, "If only we had died in the destruction of our brethren before the Lord!
verses.20:4: And why have you brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, to kill us and our livestock?
verses.20:5: And why have you brought us up out of Egypt like this, to come to this place? It is a place where nothing is sown, nor are there figs, nor vines, nor pomegranates; neither is there water to drink."
verses.20:6: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the congregation to the door of the tabernacle of testimony, and fell on their faces; and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
verses.20:7: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.20:8: "Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before them, and it shall yield its waters; and you shall bring forth water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their livestock."
verses.20:9: So Moses took the rod that was before the Lord, just as the Lord commanded.
verses.20:10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, "Hear me, you disobedient ones! Shall we bring forth water for you out of this rock?"
verses.20:11: Then Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock twice with the rod; and abundant water came forth, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.20:12: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe so as to sanctify Me before the sons of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them."
verses.20:13: This is the water of Contradiction, because the sons of Israel contended before the Lord, and He was sanctified among them.
verses.20:14: Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying, "Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
verses.20:15: and our fathers went down into Egypt, and we sojourned in Egypt for many days, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers;
verses.20:16: and we cried out to the Lord, and the Lord heard our voice, and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and now we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your borders.
verses.20:17: We will pass through your land; we will not go through fields or through vineyards, nor will we drink water from your cistern; we will travel by the royal highway, and we will not turn aside to the right or to the left until we have passed through your borders."
verses.20:18: Then Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through me; otherwise I will come out in war to meet you."
verses.20:19: And the sons of Israel said to him, "We will pass along by the mountain; and if I and the livestock drink of your water, I will pay you the price; yet the matter is nothing—we will pass along by the mountain."
verses.20:20: But he said, "You shall not pass through me." And Edom came out to meet him with a heavy multitude and with a strong hand.
verses.20:21: Thus Edom would not grant Israel to pass through his borders; so Israel turned away from him.
verses.20:22: Now they departed from Kadesh; and the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.20:23: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the borders of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.20:24: "Let Aaron be gathered to his people, for you shall by no means enter into the land which I have given to the sons of Israel, because you provoked Me at the water of Reviling.
verses.20:25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up onto Mount Hor before all the congregation;
verses.20:26: and strip Aaron of his robe and put it on Eleazar his son; and let Aaron be gathered and die there."
verses.20:27: So Moses did just as the Lord commanded, and he brought him up onto Mount Hor before all the congregation.
verses.20:28: And he stripped Aaron of his garments and clothed Eleazar his son with them; and Aaron died on the summit of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.20:29: And all the congregation saw that Aaron had departed; and all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.
verses.21:1: Now the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt by the wilderness, heard—for Israel had come by the way of Atharim—and he fought against Israel, and they took captives from among them.
verses.21:2: So Israel vowed a vow to the Lord and said, "If You deliver this people into my hand, I will devote him and his cities to destruction."
verses.21:3: And the Lord heard the voice of Israel and delivered the Canaanite into his hand; and he devoted him and his cities to destruction, and they called the name of that place Anathema.
verses.21:4: Then they departed from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, and went around the land of Edom; and the people became fainthearted along the way.
verses.21:5: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, saying, "Why have you brought us out of Egypt like this, to slay us in the wilderness? For there is no bread and no water, and our soul loathes this empty bread."
verses.21:6: So the Lord sent the deadly serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of the sons of Israel died.
verses.21:7: Therefore the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, because we have spoken against the Lord and against you; pray therefore to the Lord, and let Him take away the serpent from us."
verses.21:8: So Moses prayed to the Lord for the people. And the Lord said to Moses, "Make for yourself a serpent, and set it on a standard; and it shall be that if a serpent bites a man, everyone who is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live."
verses.21:9: So Moses made a bronze serpent and set it up on a standard; and it came to pass that whenever a serpent bit a man, and he looked upon the bronze serpent, he lived.
verses.21:10: Then the sons of Israel departed and encamped in Oboth.
verses.21:11: And departing from Oboth, they encamped at Chalgaei on the other side, in the wilderness that is opposite Moab, toward the rising of the sun.
verses.21:12: From there they departed, and encamped in the Valley of Zared.
verses.21:13: Departing from there, they encamped on the other side of the Arnon in the wilderness that extends from the borders of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite.
verses.21:14: Therefore it is said in the book, War of the Lord, "He set Zoob ablaze, and the torrents of Arnon;
verses.21:15: and He appointed the torrents to settle Ar, and it lies adjacent to the borders of Moab."
verses.21:16: And from there to the well; this is the well of which the Lord spoke to Moses, "Gather the people together, and I will give them water to drink."
verses.21:17: Then Israel sang this song at the well: "Lead the song to it:
verses.21:18: A well! Princes dug it, kings of the nations hewed it out, in their reign, when they held dominion." And from the well to Manthanain;
verses.21:20: and from Manthanain to Manael; and from Manael to Bamoth; and from Bamoth to Janen, which is in the plain of Moab, from the summit of the hewn height that looks out toward the face of the wilderness.
verses.21:21: Then Moses sent envoys to Sihon, king of the Amorites, with words of peace, saying, "We will pass through your land; we will travel along the road; we will not turn aside either into a field or into a vineyard,
verses.21:22: we will not drink water from your well; we will travel by the royal highway until we have passed through your borders."
verses.21:23: But Sihon did not grant Israel to pass through his borders; instead Sihon gathered all his people together and went out into the wilderness to do battle against Israel, and he came to Jahaz and arrayed himself in battle against Israel.
verses.21:24: And Israel struck him with the slaughter of the sword, and they took dominion over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon; for Jazer is the border of the sons of Ammon.
verses.21:25: So Israel took all these cities; and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all those adjoining it.
verses.21:26: For Heshbon is the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites; and he had fought against the king of Moab formerly, and they took all his land from Aroer as far as the Arnon.
verses.21:27: Therefore the speakers of riddles say, "Come to Heshbon, that the city of Sihon may be built and established.
verses.21:28: For fire went forth from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon; and it devoured as far as Moab, and swallowed up the pillars of Arnon.
verses.21:29: Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, O people of Chemosh! Their sons were given up to flee for safety, and their daughters as captives, to Sihon, king of the Amorites.
verses.21:30: And their seed shall perish, Heshbon as far as Dibon, and the women have yet further kindled a fire against Moab."
verses.21:31: Thus Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites.
verses.21:32: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer, and they captured it and its villages, and drove out the Amorite who dwelt there.
verses.21:33: Then they turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Og, king of Bashan, went out to meet them, and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.21:34: And the Lord said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hands, and all his people and all his land; and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon."
verses.21:35: So he struck him and his sons and all his people, until no survivor of his was left; and they inherited their land.
verses.22:1: And the sons of Israel set out and encamped on the west of Moab, beside the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.22:2: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorite,
verses.22:3: and Moab feared the people exceedingly, because they were many; and Moab was vexed at the presence of the sons of Israel.
verses.22:4: And Moab said to the council of elders of Midian, "Now this congregation will lick up all those around us, as the calf licks up the green herbage from the field." And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.22:5: And he sent ambassadors to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is upon the river of the land of the sons of his people, to summon him, saying, "Behold, a people has come out from Egypt, and behold, it has covered the face of the earth; and this people sits settled close to me.
verses.22:6: And now come, curse this people for me, for it is stronger than we are, so that we may perhaps be able to strike some of them, and I shall drive them out from the land; for I know that those whom you bless are blessed, and those whom you curse are cursed."
verses.22:7: And the council of elders of Moab and the council of elders of Midian departed, and the divinations were in their hands; and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.22:8: And he said to them, "Lodge here through the night, and I will answer you the matters which the Lord shall speak to me." And the princes of Moab remained with Balaam.
verses.22:9: And God came to Balaam and said to him, "Why are these men with you?"
verses.22:10: And Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent them to me, saying,
verses.22:11: 'Behold, a people has come out from Egypt, and behold, it has covered the face of the earth, and this people sits settled close to me; and now come, curse it for me, if indeed I may be able to strike it and drive it out from the land.'"
verses.22:12: And God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them, nor shall you curse the people, for it is blessed."
verses.22:13: And Balaam arose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Return quickly to your lord; God does not permit me to go with you."
verses.22:14: And the princes of Moab arose, and came to Balak, and said, "Balaam is not willing to go with us."
verses.22:15: And Balak sent yet again princes more numerous and more honorable than these.
verses.22:16: And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: 'I urge you, do not hesitate to come to me;
verses.22:17: for I will honor you with great honor, and whatever you say I will do for you; and come, curse this people for me.'"
verses.22:18: And Balaam answered and said to the princes of Balak, "Though Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I shall not be able to transgress the word of the Lord God, to make it small or great in my own mind.
verses.22:19: And now stay here, you also, this night, and I shall know what further the Lord will speak to me."
verses.22:20: And God came to Balaam and said to him, "If these men have come to summon you, arise and follow them; yet the word which I shall speak to you, that you shall do."
verses.22:21: And Balaam arose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.22:22: And God was provoked with wrath because he went, and the Angel of God stood up to oppose him; now he was riding upon his donkey, and two of his servants were with him.
verses.22:23: And when the donkey saw the Angel of God standing against him in the road, with His sword drawn in His hand, the donkey turned aside out of her road and went into the field; and he struck the donkey with the staff, to turn her straight back into the road.
verses.22:24: And the Angel of God stood in the furrows of the vineyards, a fence on this side and a fence on that side;
verses.22:25: and when the donkey saw the Angel of God, she pressed him against the wall and crushed the foot of Balaam; and he went on to lash her yet again.
verses.22:26: And the Angel of God went further, and departing stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.22:27: And when the donkey saw the Angel of God, she lay down beneath Balaam; and Balaam became furious and kept beating the donkey with the staff.
verses.22:28: And God opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me this third time?"
verses.22:29: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have mocked me; and if I had a sword in my hand, I would already have pierced you through."
verses.22:30: And the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey, upon which you have ridden from your youth until this very day? Have I ever acted thus toward you in utter disregard?" And he said, "No."
verses.22:31: Then God uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of the Lord standing against him in the road, with His sword drawn in His hand; and he bowed down and worshiped upon his face.
verses.22:32: And the Angel of God said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey this third time? Behold, I have come forth to oppose you, because your way is not pleasing before Me; and when the donkey saw Me, she turned aside from Me this third time.
verses.22:33: And had she not turned aside, surely now I would have slain you, and spared her alive."
verses.22:34: And Balaam said to the Angel of the Lord, "I have sinned, for I did not know that You stood against me in the road to meet me; and now, if it is not pleasing to You, I will turn back."
verses.22:35: And the Angel of God said to Balaam, "Go with the men; yet the word which I shall speak to you, that you shall take care to speak." And Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.22:36: And when Balak heard that Balaam had arrived, he went out to meet him to a city of Moab, which is upon the borders of the Arnon, which is at the edge of the borders.
verses.22:37: And Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send to you to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Shall I not truly be able to honor you?"
verses.22:38: And Balaam said to Balak, "Behold, I have come to you now; shall I be able to speak anything? The word which God puts into my mouth, that I shall speak."
verses.22:39: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Cities of Villages.
verses.22:40: And Balak sacrificed sheep and calves, and sent to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.
verses.22:41: And it came to pass in the morning that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the pillar of Baal, and from there he showed him a part of the people.
verses.23:1: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven calves and seven rams."
verses.23:2: And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken to him, and he offered up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
verses.23:3: And Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your sacrifice, and I will go, to see if God will appear to meet me; and whatever word He shows me, I will declare to you." And Balak stood beside his sacrifice,
verses.23:4: and Balaam went to inquire of God, and he went straight ahead. And God appeared to Balaam, and Balaam said to Him, "I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a calf and a ram upon the altar."
verses.23:5: And God put a word into the mouth of Balaam and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.23:6: And he returned to him, and there he stood beside his burnt offerings, and all the princes of Moab were with him. And the Spirit of God came upon him;
verses.23:7: and taking up his parable, he said, "From Mesopotamia Balak sent for me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east, saying, 'Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, invoke a curse upon Israel for me.'
verses.23:8: Why should I curse him whom the Lord does not curse? Or why should I curse him whom God does not curse?
verses.23:9: For from the summit of the mountains I shall see him, and from the hills I shall behold him; behold, a people shall dwell alone, and among the nations it shall not be reckoned.
verses.23:10: Who has accurately calculated the seed of Jacob? And who shall count the peoples of Israel? May my soul die among the souls of the righteous, and may my seed be as the seed of these!"
verses.23:11: And Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I summoned you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them with a blessing!"
verses.23:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Whatever God puts into my mouth, shall I not take care to speak this?"
verses.23:13: And Balak said to him, "Come again with me to another place, from which you shall not see him, except that you shall see a part of him, and all of them you shall by no means see; and curse him for me from there."
verses.23:14: And he took him to the lookout of a field, to the summit of the Hewn Rock, and he built seven altars there, and offered up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
verses.23:15: And Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your sacrifice, and I will go to inquire of God."
verses.23:16: And God met Balaam, and put a word into his mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.23:17: And he returned to him, and he was standing beside his burnt offering, and all the princes of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the Lord spoken?"
verses.23:18: And taking up his parable, he said, "Arise, Balak, and hear; give ear as a witness, son of Zippor!
verses.23:19: God is not as a man, to be deceived, nor as a son of man, to be threatened; having spoken, shall He not perform it? Shall He speak, and not abide by it?
verses.23:20: Behold, I have been commissioned to bless; I will bless, and I will by no means turn back.
verses.23:21: There shall be no hardship in Jacob, nor shall toil be seen in Israel; the Lord his God is with him, and the glories of rulers are in him.
verses.23:22: It is God who brought them out from Egypt; as the glory of a unicorn is his.
verses.23:23: For there is no augury in Jacob, nor divination in Israel; in due season it shall be told to Jacob and to Israel what God shall accomplish.
verses.23:24: Behold, a people shall rise up as a lion cub, and as a lion it shall exult; it shall not lie down until it devours the prey, and it shall drink the blood of the slain."
verses.23:25: And Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse him for me with curses, nor bless him at all."
verses.23:26: And Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not speak to you, saying, 'The word which God speaks, that I will do'?"
verses.23:27: And Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place, if it will be pleasing to God, and curse him for me from there."
verses.23:28: And Balak took Balaam to the summit of Peor, which extends toward the wilderness.
verses.23:29: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven calves and seven rams."
verses.23:30: And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken to him, and he offered up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
verses.24:1: And when Balaam saw that it was good before the Lord to bless Israel, he did not go, as was his custom, to meet with omens, but turned his face toward the wilderness.
verses.24:2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and beheld Israel encamped according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came within him.
verses.24:3: And taking up his parable, he said, "Balaam the son of Beor says, the man who truly sees says,
verses.24:4: he who hears the oracles of God says, who saw a vision of God in sleep, with his eyes uncovered:
verses.24:5: How fair are your houses, O Jacob, your tents, O Israel;
verses.24:6: like shady valleys, and like a garden beside rivers; and like tents which the Lord pitched, like cedars beside waters.
verses.24:7: A man shall come forth from his seed, and he shall rule over many nations; and the kingdom shall be exalted higher than Gog, and his kingdom shall be increased.
verses.24:8: God led him out of Egypt; his is as the glory of a unicorn; he shall devour the nations of his enemies, and he shall drain the marrow from their fatness, and with his darts he shall shoot down the enemy.
verses.24:9: Lying down, he rested like a lion and like a lion's cub; who shall rouse him? Those who bless you have been blessed, and those who curse you have been cursed."
verses.24:10: And Balak was enraged against Balaam, and he clapped his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemy, and behold, you have surely blessed him this third time.
verses.24:11: Now therefore, flee to your own place. I said, 'I will honor you,' and now the Lord has deprived you of glory."
verses.24:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.24:13: 'If Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I will not be able to transgress the word of the Lord, to make it evil or good of myself; whatever God may speak, those things I will say'?
verses.24:14: And now, behold, I am hastening away to my own place; come, I will advise you what this people shall do to your people in the last of the days."
verses.24:15: And taking up his parable, he said:
verses.24:16: "Balaam the son of Beor says, the truthful man who sees says, hearing the oracles of God, knowing knowledge from the Most High, and having seen a vision of God in sleep, with his eyes uncovered:
verses.24:17: I will show to him, yet not now; I call blessed, yet he does not draw near: a star shall rise out of Jacob, and a man shall arise out of Israel, and he shall shatter the leaders of Moab, and he shall plunder all the sons of Seth.
verses.24:18: And Edom shall be an inheritance, and Esau his enemy shall be an inheritance; and Israel acted with strength.
verses.24:19: And one shall be roused up out of Jacob, and he shall destroy whoever escapes from the city."
verses.24:20: And seeing Amalek and taking up his parable, he said, "Amalek is the first of the nations, yet their seed shall perish."
verses.24:21: And seeing the Kenite and taking up his parable, he said, "Strong is your dwelling place; and even if you set your nest in a rock,
verses.24:22: and even if Beor should have a nest of craftiness, the Assyrians shall take you captive."
verses.24:23: And seeing Og and taking up his parable, he said, "Alas, alas! Who shall live when God appoints these things?
verses.24:24: And one shall come forth from the hand of the Kittim, and they shall afflict Asshur, and they shall afflict the Hebrews, and they themselves shall perish together."
verses.24:25: And Balaam rose up and departed, returning to his own place; and Balak departed to his own home.
verses.25:1: Now Israel lodged in Shittim; and the people were profaned to commit harlotry with the daughters of Moab.
verses.25:2: And they invited them to the sacrifices of their idols, and the people ate of their sacrifices and bowed down to their idols,
verses.25:3: and Israel was initiated into Baal-Peor; and the Lord was angry in wrath against Israel.
verses.25:4: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of the people and make a public example of them to the Lord before the sun, and the wrath of the Lord shall be turned away from Israel."
verses.25:5: And Moses said to the tribes of Israel, "Let each man slay his kinsman who has been initiated into Baal-Peor."
verses.25:6: And behold, a man of the sons of Israel came and brought his brother to the Midianite woman before Moses and before all the congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping beside the door of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.25:7: And when Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and taking a spear in his hand,
verses.25:8: he went in after the Israelite man into the vaulted chamber, and pierced through both of them, both the Israelite man and the woman through her womb; and the plague ceased from the sons of Israel.
verses.25:9: And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.25:10: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:11: "Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has caused My wrath to cease from the sons of Israel, in that he was zealous with My zeal among them, so that I did not consume the sons of Israel in My zeal.
verses.25:12: Thus say: 'Behold, I give to him a covenant of peace,
verses.25:13: and it shall be to him and to his seed after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.'"
verses.25:14: Now the name of the Israelite man who was struck down, who was struck down with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salmon, a ruler of a father's house of the Simeonites.
verses.25:15: And the name of the Midianite woman who was struck down was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, ruler of the nation of Ommoth; he is of a father's house of the Midianites.
verses.25:16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying,
verses.25:17: 'Be hostile toward the Midianites and strike them down,
verses.25:18: for they themselves are hostile toward you in deceit, in all the ways they act deceitfully toward you because of Peor, and because of Cozbi, the daughter of a ruler of Midian, their sister, who was struck down in the day of the plague because of Peor.'"
verses.26:1: And it came to pass after the plague that the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, saying,
verses.26:2: "Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, according to the houses of their fathers, every one who goes forth to battle in Israel."
verses.26:3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke in Araboth of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.26:4: "From twenty years old and upward, just as the Lord commanded Moses—you and the sons of Israel who came out of Egypt."
verses.26:5: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. Now the sons of Reuben were: Hanoch, and the family of Hanoch; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
verses.26:6: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.26:7: These are the families of Reuben; and their numbering was forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:8: And the sons of Pallu were Eliab.
verses.26:9: And the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These were chosen men of the congregation; these are the ones who rose up against Moses and Aaron in the assembly of Korah, in the uprising against the Lord;
verses.26:10: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah in his assembly, when the fire devoured the two hundred and fifty, and they became a sign.
verses.26:11: Yet the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.26:12: And the sons of Simeon—the family of the sons of Simeon: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
verses.26:13: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.26:14: These are the families of Simeon from their numbering: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.26:15: Now the sons of Judah were Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.26:16: And the sons of Judah according to their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of Perez; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
verses.26:17: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Jamun, the family of the Jamunites.
verses.26:18: These are the families of Judah according to their numbering: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.26:19: And the sons of Issachar according to their families were: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puah, the family of the Puaites;
verses.26:20: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Samaram, the family of the Samaranites.
verses.26:21: These are the families of Issachar from their numbering: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.26:22: The sons of Zebulun according to their families were: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.26:23: These are the families of Zebulun from their numbering: sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:24: The sons of Gad according to their families were: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
verses.26:25: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Addi, the family of the Addites;
verses.26:26: of Arodi, the family of the Arodites; of Ariel, the family of the Arielites.
verses.26:27: These are the families of the sons of Gad from their numbering: forty-four thousand five hundred.
verses.26:28: The sons of Asher according to their families were: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites;
verses.26:29: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Melliel, the family of the Mellielites.
verses.26:30: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Kara.
verses.26:31: These are the families of Asher from their numbering: forty-three thousand six hundred.
verses.26:32: The sons of Joseph according to their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.26:33: The sons of Manasseh were: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.26:34: And these are the sons of Gilead: Ahiezer, the family of the Ahiezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.26:35: of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.26:36: of Symaer, the family of the Symaerites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.26:37: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of the daughters of Zelophehad: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.26:38: These are the families of Manasseh from their numbering: fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.26:39: And these are the sons of Ephraim: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Tanach, the family of the Tanachites.
verses.26:40: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eden, the family of the Edenites.
verses.26:41: These are the families of Ephraim from their numbering: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the families of the sons of Joseph according to their families.
verses.26:42: The sons of Benjamin according to their families were: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Jachiran, the family of the Jachiranites;
verses.26:43: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites.
verses.26:44: And the sons of Bela were Adar and Noemani.
verses.26:45: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their families from their numbering: thirty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.26:46: And the sons of Dan according to their families were: of Shami, the family of the Shamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.
verses.26:47: All the families of the Shamites according to their numbering were sixty-four thousand six hundred.
verses.26:48: The sons of Naphtali according to their families were: of Sael, the family of the Saelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.26:49: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.26:50: These are the families of Naphtali from their numbering: thirty thousand three hundred.
verses.26:51: This was the numbering of the sons of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:52: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.26:53: "To these the land shall be divided to inherit according to the number of names.
verses.26:54: To the larger number you shall increase the inheritance, and to the smaller you shall diminish their inheritance; to each one, just as they were numbered, their inheritance shall be given.
verses.26:55: By lots the land shall be divided according to the names; according to the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.26:56: By the lot you shall divide their inheritance between the many and the few."
verses.26:57: And the sons of Levi according to their families were: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.26:58: These are the families of the sons of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of Korah, and the family of the Mushites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.26:59: And the name of his wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who bore these to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.26:60: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, and Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.26:61: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.26:62: And those from their numbering were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered together in the midst of the sons of Israel, because no portion is given to them in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.26:63: And this was the numbering by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho;
verses.26:64: and among these there was not a man of those numbered by Moses and Aaron, whom they numbered of the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai;
verses.26:65: for the Lord had said to him, "They shall surely die in the wilderness." And not even one of them was left, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.27:1: Then the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, of the family of Manasseh of the sons of Joseph, came near; and these were their names: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.27:2: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the rulers, and before all the congregation, at the door of the tabernacle of testimony, saying,
verses.27:3: "Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the midst of the congregation that banded together against the Lord in the congregation of Korah; for he died for his own sin, and he had no sons. May the name of our father not be blotted out from the midst of his family because he has no son; give us a possession among our father's brethren."
verses.27:5: And Moses brought their case before the Lord.
verses.27:6: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.27:7: "The daughters of Zelophehad have spoken rightly; you shall surely give them as a gift a possession of inheritance among their father's brethren, and you shall transfer the allotment of their father to them. And you shall speak to the sons of Israel.
verses.27:8: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'If a man dies and has no son, you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.27:9: And if he has no daughter, you shall give the inheritance to his brother.
verses.27:10: And if he has no brothers, you shall give the inheritance to his father's brother.
verses.27:11: And if his father has no brothers, you shall give the inheritance to his nearest kinsman from his tribe; he shall inherit what is his.'" And this shall be to the sons of Israel a statute of judgment, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.27:12: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go up to the mountain that is in the region beyond, this Mount Nebo, and behold the land of Canaan, which I give to the sons of Israel for a possession.
verses.27:13: And you shall see it, and you also shall be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother was gathered on Mount Hor,
verses.27:14: because you transgressed My word in the Wilderness of Zin, when the congregation contended, to sanctify Me—you did not sanctify Me at the water before them." This is the water of Contention at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
verses.27:15: Then Moses spoke to the Lord, saying,
verses.27:16: "Let the Lord, the God of the spirits and of all flesh, appoint a man over this congregation,
verses.27:17: who shall go out before them and who shall come in before them, and who shall lead them out and who shall bring them in, and the congregation of the Lord shall not be like sheep that have no shepherd."
verses.27:18: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Take to yourself Joshua the son of Nun, a man who has the Spirit in him, and you shall lay your hands on him;
verses.27:19: and you shall set him before Eleazar the priest, and you shall charge him before all the congregation, and you shall give a charge concerning him in their sight;
verses.27:20: and you shall bestow some of your glory upon him, so that the sons of Israel may listen to him.
verses.27:21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, and they shall inquire of him for the judgment of the Manifestations before the Lord; at his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and the sons of Israel with one accord, and all the congregation."
verses.27:22: So Moses did just as the Lord commanded him; and taking Joshua, he set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.27:23: And he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.28:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.28:2: "Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'My offerings, My gifts, My offerings made by fire, for a sweet aroma, you shall be careful to offer to Me at My feasts.'
verses.28:3: And you shall say to them, 'These are the offerings made by fire which you shall bring to the Lord: two unblemished lambs a year old each day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.28:4: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer toward evening,
verses.28:5: and you shall offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice, mixed with oil, a fourth of a hin—
verses.28:6: a perpetual burnt offering, which was ordained on Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.28:7: And its drink offering shall be a fourth of a hin for the one lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord.
verses.28:8: And the second lamb you shall offer toward evening; according to its sacrifice and according to its drink offering you shall offer it, for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.28:9: And on the Sabbath day you shall bring two unblemished lambs a year old, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and a drink offering—
verses.28:10: a burnt offering of the Sabbaths on the Sabbaths, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:11: And at the new moons you shall bring burnt offerings to the Lord: two young bulls from the herd, and one ram, and seven unblemished lambs a year old;
verses.28:12: three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for each young bull, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for the one ram,
verses.28:13: and a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb, a sacrifice, a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.28:14: Their drink offering shall be half a hin for each young bull, and a third of a hin for the one ram, and a fourth of a hin of wine for each lamb. This is the burnt offering month by month for the months of the year.
verses.28:15: And one male goat from the goats for a sin offering to the Lord; it shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover of the Lord.
verses.28:17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.28:18: And the first day shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no servile work.
verses.28:19: And you shall bring burnt offerings, offerings made by fire to the Lord: two young bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven lambs a year old; they shall be unblemished for you.
verses.28:20: And their sacrifice shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each young bull and two tenths for the one ram;
verses.28:21: one tenth each you shall offer for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.28:22: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.28:23: besides the continual burnt offering of the morning, which is a perpetual burnt offering.
verses.28:24: These things, in this same manner, you shall offer each day for the seven days, a gift, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the Lord; in addition to the continual burnt offering you shall offer its drink offering.
verses.28:25: And the seventh day shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no servile work on it.
verses.28:26: And on the day of the new produce, when you offer a new sacrifice of the Weeks to the Lord, it shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no servile work.
verses.28:27: And you shall bring burnt offerings for a sweet aroma to the Lord: two young bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven unblemished lambs a year old;
verses.28:28: their sacrifice shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each young bull and two tenths for the one ram,
verses.28:29: one tenth each for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.28:30: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you, besides the burnt offering that is
verses.28:31: continual; and you shall offer their sacrifice to Me—they shall be unblemished for you—together with their drink offerings.'"
verses.29:1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work; it shall be a day of trumpet signal for you.
verses.29:2: And you shall offer burnt offerings for a sweet aroma to the Lord: one young bull from the herd, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:3: their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the one young bull, and two tenths for the one ram,
verses.29:4: one tenth each for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:5: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.29:6: besides the burnt offerings of the new moon, and their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and the continual burnt offerings, and their grain offerings and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.29:7: And on the tenth day of this month you shall have a holy convocation; and you shall afflict your souls, and you shall do no work.
verses.29:8: And you shall present burnt offerings for a sweet aroma, offerings made by fire to the Lord: one young bull from the herd, one ram, seven yearling lambs; they shall be without blemish for you;
verses.29:9: their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the one young bull, and two tenths for the one ram,
verses.29:10: one tenth each for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:11: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.29:12: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work, and celebrate it as a feast of the Lord for seven days.
verses.29:13: And you shall present burnt offerings, offerings made by fire for a sweet aroma to the Lord: on the first day, thirteen young bulls from the herd, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs; they shall be without blemish;
verses.29:14: their grain offerings shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each young bull of the thirteen young bulls, and two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
verses.29:15: one tenth each for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.29:16: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:17: And on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:18: their grain offering and their drink offering for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:19: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:20: On the third day: eleven young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:21: their grain offering and their drink offering for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:22: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:23: On the fourth day: ten young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:24: their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:25: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:26: On the fifth day: nine young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:27: their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:28: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:29: On the sixth day: eight young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:30: their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:31: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:32: On the seventh day: seven young bulls, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs;
verses.29:33: their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:34: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:35: And on the eighth day you shall have a solemn closing assembly; you shall do no servile work on it.
verses.29:36: And you shall present burnt offerings for a sweet aroma, offerings made by fire to the Lord: one young bull, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;
verses.29:37: their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the young bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:38: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, their grain offerings, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:39: These things you shall offer to the Lord at your feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, and your burnt offerings, and your grain offerings, and your drink offerings, and your offerings of deliverance.
verses.30:1: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.30:2: And Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes of Israel, saying, "This is the word which the Lord has commanded:
verses.30:3: Any man who vows a vow to the Lord, or swears an oath with a binding pledge, or binds himself concerning his soul, shall not profane his word; he shall do all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.30:4: And if a woman vows a vow to the Lord, or binds herself by a pledge in the house of her father in her youth,
verses.30:5: and her father hears her vows and her pledges which she has bound upon her soul, and her father holds his peace toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the pledges which she has bound upon her soul shall remain upon her.
verses.30:6: But if her father expressly forbids her on the day that he hears all her vows and the pledges which she has bound upon her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord shall cleanse her, because her father forbade her.
verses.30:7: And if she indeed becomes married to a husband, while her vows are upon her according to the declaration of her lips, which she has bound upon her soul,
verses.30:8: and her husband hears of it, and holds his peace toward her on the day that he hears, then thus all her vows shall stand, and her pledges which she has bound upon her soul shall stand.
verses.30:9: But if her husband expressly forbids her on the day that he hears, all her vows and her pledges which she has bound upon her soul shall not remain, because her husband has refused her; and the Lord shall cleanse her.
verses.30:10: And the vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, whatever she vows upon her soul, shall remain upon her.
verses.30:11: And if her vow, or the pledge upon her soul with an oath, is in the house of her husband,
verses.30:12: and her husband hears of it, and holds his peace toward her and does not forbid her, then all her vows shall stand, and all her pledges which she has bound upon her soul shall stand against her.
verses.30:13: But if her husband completely annuls them on the day that he hears, all that proceeds out of her lips concerning her vows and concerning the pledges upon her soul shall not remain upon her; her husband has annulled them, and the Lord shall cleanse her.
verses.30:14: Every vow and every oath of a bond to afflict the soul, her husband may establish for her, and her husband may annul it.
verses.30:15: And if he altogether holds his peace toward her from day to day, then he shall establish for her all her vows, and the pledges that are upon her he shall establish for her, because he held his peace toward her on the day that he heard.
verses.30:16: But if he completely annuls them for her after the day that he heard, then he shall bear his sin."
verses.30:17: These are the ordinances which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and a daughter in her youth in her father's house.
verses.31:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Execute the vengeance of the sons of Israel upon the Midianites, and afterward you shall be added to your people."
verses.31:3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you to array for battle before the Lord against Midian, to render vengeance from the Lord upon Midian.
verses.31:4: A thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe—from all the tribes of Israel send them out to array for battle."
verses.31:5: So they numbered out from the thousands of Israel a thousand from each tribe: twelve thousand, armed for battle.
verses.31:6: And Moses sent them, a thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, with their host, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest; and the holy vessels and the signaling trumpets were in their hands.
verses.31:7: And they arrayed for battle against Midian, just as the Lord commanded Moses, and they slew every male.
verses.31:8: And they slew the kings of Midian along with their slain: Evi, and Zur, and Rekem, and Hur, and Robok, five kings of Midian; and Balaam the son of Beor they slew with the sword along with their slain.
verses.31:9: And they took as plunder the women of Midian, and their little ones, and their livestock, and all their possessions, and their wealth they plundered.
verses.31:10: And all their cities in their dwelling places, and their encampments, they burned with fire.
verses.31:11: And they took all the plunder and all their spoils, from man to beast.
verses.31:12: And they brought to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to all the sons of Israel, the captives and the spoils and the plunder, to the camp at Araboth of Moab, which is by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.31:13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the rulers of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.31:14: And Moses was angry with the overseers of the host, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, who were coming from the battle array of the war.
verses.31:15: And Moses said to them, "Why have you kept every female alive?
verses.31:16: For these were the ones who, according to the word of Balaam, caused the sons of Israel to turn away and disregard the word of the Lord on account of Peor, and the plague came upon the congregation of the Lord.
verses.31:17: Now therefore slay every male among all the little ones, and every woman who has known the bed of a male you shall slay;
verses.31:18: but all the little ones among the women who have not known the bed of a male, keep them alive.
verses.31:19: And as for you, encamp outside the camp seven days; everyone who has slain anyone, and whoever touches the slain, shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
verses.31:20: And every garment, and every article of leather, and every work of goats' hair, and every article of wood, you shall purify."
verses.31:21: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of the host who were coming from the battle array of the war, "This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses:
verses.31:22: Only the gold, and the silver, and bronze, and iron, and lead, and tin—
verses.31:23: every item shall pass through fire, and it shall be cleansed, yet with the water of purification it shall be purified; and all things that do not pass through fire shall pass through water.
verses.31:24: And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day, and you shall be cleansed; and after these things you shall enter into the camp."
verses.31:25: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take the sum of the spoils of the captivity, from man to beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the rulers of the fathers' houses of the congregation;
verses.31:27: and you shall divide the spoils between the warriors who went out to the battle array and all the congregation.
verses.31:28: And you shall set apart a tribute for the Lord from the men of war who went out to the battle array: one soul out of five hundred, of the people, and of the livestock, and of the oxen, and of the sheep, and of the goats;
verses.31:29: and from their half you shall take it, and you shall give it to Eleazar the priest as the firstfruits of the Lord.
verses.31:30: And from the half belonging to the sons of Israel you shall take one out of fifty, of the people, and of the oxen, and of the sheep, and of the donkeys, and of all the livestock, and you shall give them to the Levites who keep the charges in the tabernacle of the Lord."
verses.31:31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:32: And the remainder of the plunder which the men of war had plundered was, of the sheep, six hundred and seventy-five thousand;
verses.31:35: and human souls, of the women who had not known the bed of a man, all the souls were thirty-two thousand.
verses.31:36: And the half, the portion of those who had gone out to war, was, of the number of the sheep, three hundred and thirty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.31:37: And the tribute for the Lord from the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five;
verses.31:38: and the oxen were thirty-six thousand, and the tribute for the Lord was seventy-two;
verses.31:39: and the donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute for the Lord was sixty-one;
verses.31:40: and the human souls were sixteen thousand, and their tribute for the Lord was thirty-two souls.
verses.31:41: And Moses gave the tribute for the Lord, the set-apart offering of God, to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:42: From the half belonging to the sons of Israel, whom Moses separated from the men of war—
verses.31:43: now the half belonging to the congregation was, of the sheep, three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
verses.31:47: And Moses took from the half belonging to the sons of Israel the one out of fifty, of the people and of the livestock, and gave them to the Levites who keep the charges of the tabernacle of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:48: And all those appointed over the divisions of thousands of the host, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;
verses.31:49: and they said to Moses, "Your servants have taken the count of the men of war who are with us, and not even one of them is missing.
verses.31:50: Therefore we have brought the offering to the Lord, whatever article of gold each man found—anklet, and bracelet, and ring, and armlet, and hair ornament—to make atonement for ourselves before the Lord."
verses.31:51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from them, every wrought article.
verses.31:52: And all the gold, the set-apart offering which they set apart for the Lord, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from the captains of thousands and from the captains of hundreds.
verses.31:53: And the men of war had taken plunder, each man for himself.
verses.31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the captains of thousands and from the captains of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of testimony as a memorial for the sons of Israel before the Lord.
verses.32:1: Now the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had a multitude of livestock, an exceedingly great multitude; and they saw the region of Jazer and the region of Gilead, and the place was a place for livestock.
verses.32:2: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the rulers of the congregation, saying,
verses.32:3: "Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sibmah, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.32:4: the land which the Lord has delivered before the children of Israel, is a land for raising livestock, and your servants have livestock."
verses.32:5: And they said, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants as a possession, and do not bring us across the Jordan."
verses.32:6: And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, "Do your brethren go to war, and shall you sit here?
verses.32:7: And why do you turn aside the minds of the children of Israel from crossing over into the land which the Lord is giving them?
verses.32:8: Did your fathers not do thus when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to inspect the land?
